player_prompt.intro:
Nekk d Amurar {player_id} itturaren tamudemt n Pig Dice.

Tisurfatin:
- Di turak, tzemreḍ ad tekkiḍ '[roll]' neɣ '[hold]'
- Ṭṭer 2-6: Rnu ɣer turak total
- Ṭṭer 1: Ttu turak total d uqeddem turak
- Ḥebsi: Rnu turak total ɣer score-inek d uqeddem turak
- Amenzu i {winning_score} points iṛummen

Mi d turak, ad ẓreḍ scores d turak total.
Ssuter s '[roll]' ad ṭṭer tiqqit neɣ '[hold]' ad ḥebsi points-inek.
